examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Idle copy button. Activating it writes the value to the clipboard and briefly confirms success.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CopyButton from '@aziontech/webkit/copy-button'
</script>

<template>
  <CopyButton
    value="https://example.com/deploy/abc123"
    ariaLabel="Copy URL"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled state — interaction is blocked and disabled tokens are applied.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CopyButton from '@aziontech/webkit/copy-button'
</script>

<template>
  <CopyButton
    value="https://example.com/deploy/abc123"
    ariaLabel="Copy URL"
    disabled
  />
</template>
